cases.scope: Photo-led US auto physical-damage claims, from photo intake through estimate review and repair coordination.

questions.text: What evidence establishes CCC's role in insurer and repairer coordination, and which participants retain effective action rights?
questions.rationale: Distinguish workflow participation from control of decisions.

questions.text: What limits or counter-evidence constrain a claim of operational dependency on CCC, including carrier or core-platform control and substitution?
questions.rationale: Do not extend evidence to the entire claim lifecycle or payment without direct support.

cases.scope: Creative Cloud production workflow, from creation through collaboration and delivery.

questions.text: What evidence establishes how Creative Cloud integrates the production workflow and constrains switching?
questions.rationale: Identify documented mechanisms and the participants that control them.

questions.text: What limits and counter-evidence distinguish product capability or marketing arguments from established operational dependency?
questions.rationale: Preserve attribution, uncertainty and viable alternatives.
